title: heloniopsis orientalis var. flavida
intro: Heloniopsis orientalis var. flavida, commonly known as the Yellow Autumn Lily, is a plant species belonging to the family Melanthiaceae. The Yellow Autumn Lily is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are said to help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, fever, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce pain, lower fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides.
